_comment: Pre-generated wizard avatars + tavern background. Loaded on first run to skip the 10-minute generation step. Only per-model wizards (detected from ComfyUI) need to be generated at runtime. Each studio wizard has a still_*.png (frame 0 of the animation, used as the menu thumbnail) and an anim_*.mp4 (canonical LTX 2.3 i2v loopable output, used in the header when the wizard is active). See docs/VIDEO_PIPELINES_CANON.md §16.3 for the bake recipe.
